narration: We keep three pointers. Point one back to null. Then two points back to one. Three to two. Four to three. Four is the new head.
description: Reverse a linked list 1→2→3→4. Show prev and curr pointers; each beat re-points one node's next arrow backwards (first to null), marks reversed nodes done, and advances prev/curr. End with node 4 marked found as the new head. Below, show the line of code being executed: curr.next = prev.
